name: Play a free untapped land that unlocks a hand card on turn 1-2
intent: On turn 1 or 2, before anything else about the land drop is decided, play a land from hand that already enters untapped and makes some other hand card payable that is not payable now - an Island that lets Otherworldly Gaze be cast. This never costs life and never asks the fetch machinery to run, so it goes first: a land this good is never worse than holding it. Prefers a basic first, since instant-reanimator's own duals and utility lands are never scarcer to hold onto than a basic. Only turns 1-2, only with the land drop still available, and only mine, precombat main, an empty stack. Does not ask about a shockland (open-shock-unlocks) or a fetch (open-fetch-unlocks); those pay something or need a search and rank below this. Stands down once the discard outlet (a creature with an own +1/+1-counter-put ability, Psychic Frog in this 60) is already on the battlefield: that fact is byte-identical to the seat-admitted bin-fatty-vs-permanent-exile play's own battlefield-outlet true key, and it can never hold on a genuine turn 1-2 board anyway - the outlet costs two mana and has to survive a turn cycle before that play reads it as safe to fire, so this key costs this play nothing here and only prevents the two plays overlapping later in the game.
